last_handoff.completed_in_this_session: THE LUMI PRODUCT ART CHANGED: the blue dino plush became the CREAM RABBIT (founder supplied one PNG, one colourway). MERGED AND LIVE (merge 6f8740a, --no-ff, revert the whole round with `git revert -m 1 6f8740a`; rollback tag pre-lumi-rabbit-2026-08-25 = 24289cc, cut BEFORE the merge and verified NOT pointing at it). Founder approved the two held copy lines before the push. THE CENTRAL FIX: the same asset used to be described independently at ten call sites (hard-coded src, hard-coded width/height, a differently-worded alt at each), which is why changing the plush was a ten-file job. Lumi is a ROTATING SKU by brand law, so its art now gets what prices/labels/ages already have: ONE source, src/lib/lumi-art.ts (LUMI_ART + lumiAlt()). The next plush change is that file plus a PNG. THE ASSET: the supplied cutout had its background removed but a soft matte everywhere (body at alpha 251-254 not 255, faint white haze to the frame edge). Thresholded to the house profile and PROVEN by compositing over black - `sips -g hasAlpha` is not proof. Deliberately NOT run through tools/cutout: its neutral-halo pass erases pixels where min(rgb)>170 and max-min<24, and cream fur is (236,225,213), spread 23, so that rule (written for a BLUE product) would have eaten this plush's own edge. THE HERO could not be swapped by file: public/hero/kheelu-lumi.png was ONE baked render holding Kheelu and the old Lumi, and extraction has no seam (Kheelu's glasses are blue, the dino's belly and hat are cream). So the hero shows LUMI ALONE, and gemini-handoff/hero-2026-08/ carries the founder kit to regenerate the whisper composite with the rabbit. data-hero-has-kheelu came OFF with it - KheeluGuide reads it to suppress the corner guide so two Kheelus never share a viewport, and with Kheelu out of the artwork the guide greets normally again; HeroStage.test asserts its absence, which is the reminder to restore it. COLOURWAYS collapsed to one; the picker STAYS by founder choice as a single Cream swatch (#f0e2d2, sampled from the render), and a second colourway is a row in COLORWAYS and nothing else. DELETED: LumiHero.tsx (exported, imported nowhere, no test, no story, carried the most aggressive image config in the repo so it read as live), lumi-blue-2/green-2/pink-2.png, and the old hero composite. NEW GUARD test/lumi-art.test.ts closes a real gap - nothing in this repo asserted that an image referenced by code EXISTS or that a width/height pair matched the file, which is how og.png shipped a retired age band through three copy rounds. It reads the PNG IHDR, and was proven RED before it was trusted; its first regex caught 'Why is the sky blue?', the child's question and one of the site's best lines, so it is now scoped to a plush described as sky blue rather than to the words. GATES: 886 tests, tsc 0, build 0, token-check 16 mappings, eslint identical to main (37 problems), qa:sweep 34/34 clean with 79 accepted - IDENTICAL to the live baseline captured before any edit. Lighthouse mobile devtools-throttled: home 99, lumi 98, a11y 96 (color-contrast only, the accepted 8.29 pair), LCP 2.0s, CLS 0; the priority Lumi image is the OBSERVED LCP element on both hero routes at 3.1x the H1's area (PerformanceObserver, not an area proxy). Verified in a real Chrome too.
last_handoff.next_action: ONE THING IS NOW A KNOWN OPEN PROBLEM, deliberately. THE HERO SHIPS WITH THE CREAM PLUSH ON THE CREAM WASH at 1.06-1.13:1, against 3.76:1 for the blue dino it replaced: the swap silently spent contrast the old product had for free. A brand-orange hero panel was built, shipped and REVERTED at the founder's request the same day (fd6f640, reverted by 5f8400b). The revert is FOUNDER-CHOSEN, not an oversight, so anyone who notices the toy is hard to see has noticed correctly. The measurements survive in website-steps.md 8.31 because they constrain whatever is tried next: WCAG contrast is a LUMINANCE-ONLY TEXT metric and judging a product-on-ground decision by it alone rejects the best option (brand orange is 1.99:1 by ratio but deltaE 67.4 perceptually, against 31.4 for the old dino and 14.3 for the rabbit on cream); a PALE tint at 15-35% makes it WORSE, landing at the fur's own luminance and dropping to ~1.03-1.07; any future treatment must be BOUNDED TO THE ART COLUMN because a radial glow reached into the copy and put ink body text on deep orange; a solid background-colour div is not an LCP candidate (observed, not assumed) and a label-free aria-hidden fill adds no contrast nodes, so qa:sweep held at 34/34 with 79 accepted. Already rendered and measured if it is picked up again: brand orange flat, orange-ink, blue-ink (strongest numerically, cream against blue is complementary), a soft vignette, and footer cocoa. THE OTHER THING STILL HANDED OVER, unchanged: the Kheelu-and-rabbit hero composite, kit ready at gemini-handoff/hero-2026-08/ (Gemini goes through the founder, never Claude). Until it lands the hero is Lumi alone and data-hero-has-kheelu is deliberately OFF so the corner guide greets normally; that README carries the three code steps for installing the result.
